notes.title: Dev Log January 2024 - Love n Life: Happy Student
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/71e8b125844df2bbe1f7b9c326883779fe175e1d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Our Journey to Deliver the Best Demo for You[/h3]

Initially, our team set out with the goal of releasing a demo for you to enjoy this New Year.
Everyone on the team has been working tirelessly, but we recognize there are still some UX elements that need fine-tuning. While we currently have a playable demo, we’ve learned from past experiences that releasing anything less than polished would fall short of the respect we owe our valued players. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/f1a893f45f6570c82acd600ecd77d1d882b2298a.jpg[/img]

We’re pouring our hearts and minds into this passionate project because we want the best for our beloved community, who has always supported us with love and care. You deserve nothing less than our eternal gratitude and unwavering dedication. 

That being said, we’ve shared the demo with our VIP community for early feedback. We’re on track to have it polished and ready for everyone by the end of February. Stay tuned. You won’t want to miss it!

[h3]Recent Milestones[/h3]

We’d like to update you on the progress of the development. Our team is committed to raising the bar with even higher-quality gameplay and a meticulously crafted UI to ensure everything looks and feels just right.

Enhanced Socializing Matches: This is the addictive core gameplay of Happy Student. We’re adding additional visual features to better showcase the girls’ skills. Every time the ladies activate their special abilities, they’re sure to captivate you. Ready to stay focused and keep your head in the game?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/8f17ac25e378675dd4407b271f994380731d234f.jpg[/img]


We understand that items are the soul of an Inventory Management game. Our artists and game designers are working tirelessly to deliver not only quantity but also depth. Each lady and other characters have special builds designed to match them, but you’re always free to experiment with your own setups. This will promise many hours of fun and excitement, with countless possibilities for mix-and-match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/3dd42a3cebf554f1b589324a1dd90ec380a558dd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/5a651f90e546d7ccf32094cc2102ec20a78f0045.jpg[/img]


Talking about the ladies, we are taking a step further to introduce more depth to their personalities. Each encounter will bring you unforgettable experiences. Don’t for a moment think this is just another light-hearted romantic story. There is a strong passion for love, to be sure, but get ready for unexpected twists and turns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/d6934c1df0c7b3426b57986828aa12200fd35bf4.jpg[/img]


But of course, it’s not always about dating and talking. You need rest, and we understand that. There are plenty of fun activities for you to enjoy, such as playing games, sports, fishing, art sessions, and more—helping you build stronger stats and, most importantly, stronger connections with the girls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/204bc9e7cbe1d3415e9dd4f1f12689100505deda.jpg[/img]


Since you’re living on an island, there are secrets to discover. Aside from the main ladies, you will also meet other interesting personalities that, let’s just say, will bring you extraordinary moments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/4aec0951d88a4dc31f4b517f66bc0696a388882a.jpg[/img]


When we launched the teaser trailer, we were thrilled to see a surge of wishlists from all of you. Your support has been a massive motivator, and we’re more determined than ever to push this project to new heights.
[previewyoutube=K-HLx1llg9E;full][/previewyoutube]

Exciting improvements and surprises are coming your way. Thank you for believing in us!
💡 Don’t forget to support the project by wishlisting and following us on Love n Life: Happy Student. Every bit of support fuels our passion and brings us closer to delivering an unforgettable experience for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/20762faf0fde784feeaaccade7d148d655dd02ed.jpg[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3149980/Love_n_Life_Happy_Student/



And don’t forget to keep supporting our previous games—they contribute directly to the rich content we’re creating for the future!

notes.title: Fulfilling the Mission: Make Games the Community Truly Needs!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/23dd5fae9c8a87118a3b5fdc3a5e506b829807fb.jpg[/img]

It’s been 7 days since the release of Love n Life: Lucky Teacher - Light of a New Day and we’ve received so much support from all of you. Not only have many people purchased both the DLC and the base game, but we've also received valuable feedback, bug reports, and a lot of interest in our team. Although our resources are limited, the key members of our development team have been going through all the suggestions and feedback from you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2445340/Love_n_Life_Lucky_Teacher/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3216840/Love_n_Life_Lucky_Teacher__Light_of_a_New_Day/

There have been many positive contributions along the way, and we've seen a significant improvement from the early versions to the current one, receiving a lot of praise from the community. Of course, we've also received some constructive feedback, particularly from people who gave up after not making it past the first 30 minutes of the game. This feedback made us realize some shortcomings in the early game design. However, Please know that the game becomes truly engaging once features, characters, locations, items, and more are unlocked.

We’re committed to ensuring that this design limitation won’t occur in our future projects. Please continue to support us, and if you encounter bugs, we would greatly appreciate it if you could send us the save files, logs, or screenshots with the version number. This will make it much easier for our dev team to investigate and fix the issues.

[h3]Today’s Hotfix 3.2.2:[/h3]
Fixed an issue where the DLC interfered with the nurse girl, causing her to disappear from the supermarket if the DLC was not installed.

[h3]What’s next?[/h3]
There will be an update with new outfits for the three girls: Rina, the secretary, and the farmer girl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176691/ca9c7908d9642468d46f41e580f5350d2cf0a3d0.jpg[/img]

We’re also adding Trading Cards and various items for the point shop, like animated backgrounds, avatars, and emotes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176691/315d22a1054aa249fa5058e3b57ea694173f95a5.jpg[/img]

With our mission of creating "the game that the community truly needs," we encourage you to continue sharing your thoughts, feedback, and suggestions with us. We truly appreciate it. Our team will continue working on improving the Lucky Teacher project while also preparing for the sequel, Love n Life: Happy Student.

notes.title: HAPPY NEW YEAR 2023 🎉
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes. We wish you a promising and prosperous new year. Hero by Chance II is getting close to the launch stage. Be eager to meet the beautiful and hot ladies. :GladitWorkforYa:

Over two years, thanks to your love, support, and feedback, our team has improved the games greatly. Let’s take a look at how much everything has evolved. 💕

[h3]Main Battles:
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/8bbfa4957f734f30327724297c198da410fa5fd5.png[/img]

Generally improved art quality. New types of units, gameplay mechanics, Special effects, sound effects, gorgeous deployable Heroines, and more.


[h3]Other Battles:
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/0909d212e61d19579fb361a3a9a201e77d8e1d27.png[/img]

Ambush has been revamped significantly with added new mechanics, Heroines, bigger and better. In addition, experience the new siege battles in the final release.


[h3]Story Characters:
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/abcc89ddebcda9a16a36f763204f00f2584d2989.png[/img]

There is a huge upgrade in terms of visual quality. The number of unique poses for all characters (especially your beloved Heroines) increases substantially even when compared to Warlord by Chance.


[h3]Units:
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/acf6b2fd63819cdc0153891933f8f96a6b561a94.png[/img]

There are now a greater variety of units with additional skills, items, branchings to serve the richer and deeper story line. You will have more options on the battlefield, Hero.


[h3]General UI:
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/00631245c68359a0d225390287e3a81403b8e5c6.png[/img]

UI art and UX have also been improved. They now have more artistic details suitable for the world settings and theme. 



[h3]It has been an incredible journey, big thanks to your love and feedback. Please continue to support us so we can keep providing you the best experience.[/h3]

[b]See you in Hero by Chance II on Jan 6th, 2023[/b]. The ladies long to meet you, Brave Hero~ :WeWillDoIt:

notes.title: Hero by Chance II - OFFICIAL TRAILER 🔥
notes.content:
The official game is coming on January 6th, 2023. Let’s watch the official trailer for Hero by Chance II now. 🎉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627680/Love_n_War_Hero_by_Chance_II/

Get ready to plan ahead before experiencing all new features. The gorgeous ladies are waiting for the bravest Hero who can lead them to victories and it is your destiny to become one. 💪

[h3]Deployable Heroines

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/863816d47778a657e634c6dc5a5d79e740fd2ed2.gif[/img]

[/h3]The hot ladies can now be deployed on the battlefield as individual units with their own unique combat skills. If they are not deployed, you can still employ their strategic skills.


[h3]New Equipment Crafting[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/faf4b63c4880488da421e39fd12a8c3e62e03324.gif[/img]

You can also craft items that change certain units’ abilities and behaviors.


[h3]Unit Branchings[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/a637949e7ce2815e92bca4e572106c1b88c04ba9.gif[/img]

For some specific units, you can equip them with crafted items to completely change their combat abilities. For example, a melee camel cavalry can change to an archer camel cavalry with a skill that can retreat while shooting backward.


[h3]New Research & Upgrades

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/446c32e9a215c5dfd19aad57c237e8c79bf96ffe.gif[/img]

[/h3]Research and upgrade your base to make it more formidable through three branches: Military, Economy, and Technology.


[h3]Gem System

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/bdb0cef88e847979ac961ab938e33c19d61c0be9.gif[/img]

[/h3]Attach gems to your items to improve their efficiency.


[h3]Siege Battles[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/581816f1b5e7b854b7b8d2811a54f9832351cdb9.gif[/img]

A brand new gameplay mechanic allows you to lay siege to your opponent’s fortress. You can deploy catapults and siege towers to scale your opponent’s walls.


[h3]Epic Boss Fights[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/c9ea68da5b0ef967bd2e60420622803b2006968b.gif[/img]

Face off various challenging boss fights. Prove your strength before the ladies’ eyes.


[h3]Ambush[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/00cf319b3b302c5704efead2eb7807beec836157.gif[/img]

These battles have been improved with new exciting mechanics.


[h3]Richer Story & Sophisticated Drama[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40583444/dcc321ef5c7452965632afc86e5e87e697fdfa6f.png[/img]

Explore deeper into the Love n War Universe. Discover secrets, learn the world’s history, and experience a much more sophisticated drama.
